note: Keweenaw County's official parcel viewer is a login-gated Colligo GIS site (colligogis.com/desktop). The only Keweenaw parcel ArcGIS service found (MTU-hosted KCFC_GLC_HKCD_Parcels MapServer) returns 'User couldn't access this resource' (restricted, not public). The other Keweenaw parcel item is a personal Hub SQLite geodatabase (djtrepal_mtu1), not a service or a supported format. Regrid, Dynamo and Acres are paid/commercial sources.
